content.short: 1delta offers a unified lending API for borrowing, lending, looping, and position execution across DeFi protocols.
content.description: 1delta is a lending aggregation and execution platform that helps developers work across fragmented DeFi money markets through one API surface. Its data endpoints normalize lending market information, while its action endpoints build deposits, withdrawals, borrows, repayments, and more advanced multi step transactions. The protocol also supports looping and atomic position management through its composer contracts, giving apps a cleaner way to compare yields, manage risk, and execute lending workflows across multiple protocols and chains without separate integrations for each lender.
content.meta: 1delta unifies DeFi lending data and transaction building for borrowing, looping, and position management. Explore 1delta on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Intents Are Too Narrow and Too Centralized
resources.tldr: A sceptical read on intent architectures: expressive enough for swaps, awkward for much else, and reliant on a small set of solvers. Argues the design is currently oversold.

resources.title: CDP Lending: Liquity V2, Forks & River
resources.tldr: Collateralised debt positions keep being rebuilt with slightly different liquidation and rate mechanics. Compares Liquity V2 and its descendants on precisely those points.

resources.title: 3,000+ Lending Markets, Made Comparable
resources.tldr: A quoted APY means little when collateral rules, oracle choice and liquidation penalties all differ. On the work of normalising thousands of markets into something rankable.
